document_text: Positive classroom behaviour creates a safe learning environment. Teachers establish classroom rules, encourage cooperation, reward positive actions and support students when problems occur.

title: Project Based Learning
document_text: Project based learning helps students learn by investigating real world problems. Students research, collaborate, develop projects and present their findings. Teachers guide students through milestones and assessments.

title: Personalised Learning Plans
document_text: Personalised learning plans identify individual student goals, strengths and learning needs. Teachers provide flexible teaching strategies, adapted materials and regular progress assessments.

title: Blended Learning
document_text: Blended learning combines traditional classroom teaching with online learning activities. Students use digital resources, online quizzes, classroom discussions and practical exercises.
